Oghaniryukti(ohanijjutti)
Jain. Pkt. one of the Mūla sūtras; semi-canonical; deals with rules an. regulations for a. Jaina saint; ascribed to Bhadrabāhusvāmin; in 1164 gāthās (some mss. contain only 1132); called also Oghasāmācāri (Ohasāmāyāri in some mss. D. p. 165.

. Jainagranthāvalī p. 155) since it is considered to be “a. extract taken out of the 20th prābhṛta of Sāmācāri, the 3rd vastu of the ninth pūrva.”
